parameters: \n[8]?!\! What's the world comin' to, with you savin' my hide now?
It's the least I can do, Barnabas.\! I owe you the world.
Bah. Everything ya got, ya got through yer own sweat 'n grit.\! Wasn't my doin.'
It's an honor to fight by your side, after all these years.\! Can't wait to show you what I've learned.

Let's plan our approach to Centurion's Rest.\! If we go to the right, looks like we're facing two squads of Cavalry.\! Cavalry are fast and powerful warriors, but fall easily to spears.\! They're guarding a stables that we can take as a source of war horses for ourselves.

\n[8], look out for those walls!\! Those archers on top of the walls are protected from close-range attacks and their arrows will be much stronger.\! If we can break through and go up those ramps, we can take those guys out!\! Or, I can try to shoot at them from the ground level, but I'll be at a disadvantage.

Or we can go left, a more direct route.\! They've got one fort there, guarded by a pretty tough squad.\! Taking that fort won't be easy.\! \n[8], the left route is connected by roads.\! Road terrain allows all units a high degree of movement range.
Hmmm... why not both?\! More objectives to capture, more reward.
Damn, are we already too late?\! Our base at Marrenburg is under attack.\! Looks like we don't have time for the rest of the army to catch up.\! We've got to save that base!
Got it. Let's meet up with the base defender and eliminate those rebels.
\n[8], this battlefield has a lot of Woods and Forests.\! Woods, being rough terrain slows down movement a bit, but offers some protection against long-range arrow fire.
So, \n[8]. The next attack dog sent by the capital.\! Do you even know why you bleed for them?\! Perhaps not... until you've been made to bleed enough.
They've reached Centurion's Rest... fall back to the keep and prepare our final defenses.\! Donar save us...
See that Donari Temple, \n[8]?\! If our troops have fallen in battle, they can be revived there, for a fee.\! The enemy can do the same, so it's best we take those Temples no matter what.

note: supply convoy leaves SW town right away, heading to base, contains one siege cannon ammo to break the wall (or use wherever)
